At approximately 10:47 local, after achieving the target 22.5 MPa hold pressure, observed persistent pressure decay of 0.08 MPa per minute over a five-minute monitoring period, exceeding acceptable threshold of 0.02 MPa per minute defined in procedure `MNT-VSL-7`

test medium potable water at 15°C

I suspended test at 10:52 and initiated controlled depressurization at rate not exceeding 0.3 MPa per minute

drain valve, DV-7 open to containment sump

Before any re-test can be authorized, full inspection of primary weld seam, Weld-Series Gamma required

longitudinal seam fabricated by Contractor Arclight

^ use portable phased-array ultrasonic tester, unit PAUT-4 calibrated for 10 mm carbon steel
^ focus scan on a fifteen-centimeter band centered on weld crown with attention to the section between markings 7.2m and 7.8m from the forward nozzle
^ If you find any indication with an amplitude exceeding 40% DAC, pause and capture full A-scan data set before proceeding
^ do not remove insulation layer perform inspection through designated access ports only
^ If no reportable indications are found, proceed with re-test after obtaining sign-off from Inspector Malik
^ reduce re-test pressure to 20.3 MPa and extend hold time to ninety minutes
^ if you find one or more indications above the reporting level, do not commence repair
^ isolate vessel by closing master valve MV-11 and tag with red 'Hold for Engineering' label
^ transmit all collected data to central diagnostics server under project ID `C18A_Gamma_Assess`
^ priority high complete inspection and report findings by 16:00 today
